description: One document to build a company profile from, for any SEC filer (name, ticker or CIK): identity (CIK, ticker, LEI and FIGI where matched, SIC, exchange, fiscal year end), the method versions and restatement rule, the full Edgar & Edgarette card (filings, measures, Altman, Piotroski, Beneish, Sloan, the sealed 80% range, peers), and up to ten fiscal years of revenue, operating income, net income, cash flow, capital spending, R&D, dividends, assets, equity, cash, debt and EPS, each row carrying the 10-K it came from (accession number, form, filed date, XBRL tag, URL). Every figure is the company's own, from SEC EDGAR. Reporting, not investment advice. Schema pops4.profile/1; dictionary at /boards/profile/dictionary.json. From POPS4, Huang Goodman.
name: get_company_profile
title: company profile
